### The Eastern Heirs
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/the-eastern-heirs
Passage: Joshua 13:8–33
Points:
- Moses' allotment of the eastern territory demonstrates God's ongoing faithfulness in fulfilling His covenant promises.
- Historical territorial boundaries serve as lasting reminders of God's power and past deliverance of His people.
- The Levites received no earthly land because the Lord and His sacred offerings were their true portion.
- Israel's failure to expel remaining pagan inhabitants reflects a spiritual decline and loss of zeal.
- Believers should treasure God Himself as their highest reward rather than material possessions.
